title: Command Custom
description: Customize any Minecraft command to your own alias!
body:
# Command Custom

**This mod can customize commands that already exist in Minecraft into ones that you customize.**

-----

## Command Custom Button

![toggle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/135c4624a467f9aa1558ac8dbde1dd4a446d71a1.png)

## Command Custom List

![cclig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f6db5c640078638b151402e7217c971556d9ebd.png)

You can also see the list of modified commands using a command.
```sh
/command_custom_list
```

</center>

## About
**This mod allows you to customize existing Minecraft commands to your own settings; you can also edit or delete the commands you have configured.**
